https://www.cei.int/ansa/178173.text: Hungary's Orban-era top prosecutor resigns (ANSA-AFP) - BUDAPEST, 22 LUG - Hungary's prosecutor general said Wednesday he would step down following pressure from Prime Minister Peter Magyar, who called him a "puppet" of nationalist ex-leader Viktor Orban. Gabor Balint Nagy, who was appointed last year under Orban, said in a statement he was resigning "solely to safeguard the interests of the prosecutorial service". He added: "The functioning and independence of the prosecutor's office must not, under any circumstances, be compromised by the disgraceful, politically motivated struggles surrounding the prosecutor general." He also said that the "attacks" on him had "gone far beyond the bounds of acceptable professional and public debate". Since ousting Orban from power in April elections, Magyar has pushed to get rid of a host of top officials including ex-president Tamas Sulyok, who was removed by a constitutional amendment on Sunday. Orban's Fidesz party has denounced Magyar's moves as "autocratic", a charge that was often levelled against the former premier himself during his tenure. The top prosecutor's announcement comes the day after a data centre hosting Fidesz servers was raided over corruption allegations. The prime minister welcomed Nagy's resignation, which will take effect late August. "With this, the country has rid itself of yet another of Orban's puppets who was obstructing the transition to democracy," Magyar said on Facebook. "Gentlemen, who will be next?" he added. https://telex.hu/after/2026/09/05/magyar.text: Menü Kereső Magyar játékos nyerte a 2026-os GeoGuessr-világbajnokságot After Pál Tamás Debre Szabolcs Attila nyerte a 2026-os GeoGuessr-világbajnokságot. Debre a Berlinben rendezett verseny szombati döntőjében a Blinky néven játszó francia Mathieu Huet-t győzte le, és első magyarként vb-címet szerzett ebben az e-sportban. A GeoGuessr egy 2013-ban indult, Google Maps-alapú földrajzi kvízjáték. A program egy véletlenszerűen kiválasztott helyre dobja le a játékost, ahol elérhető a Google Utcakép nézete. A feladat egyszerű: meg kell tippelni az interaktív világtérképen, hogy hol található a képernyőn látható helyszín. Minél gyorsabban és pontosabban találja el valaki a helyet, annál több pontot kap. A GeoGuessr az elmúlt években a világ egyik legnépszerűbb és leglátványosabb e-sportjává nőtte ki magát. 2023 óta évente megrendezik a játék világbajnokságát, ahol a világ legjobb játékosai mérhetik össze a tudásukat. Az idei vb-t szeptember 2. és 5. között rendezték a Berlinben található Tempodromban, a verseny nyereményalapja 100 ezer dollár volt. A 21 éves Debre Szabolcs Attila évek óta a világ legjobb GeoGuessr-játékosai közé tartozik, tavaly ő nyerte a játék európai, közel-keleti és afrikai (EMEA) régiós versenyét, ami után ezüstérmes lett a vb. Most Berlinben aranyra cserélte az ezüstöt, miután a vb-döntőben 3-2-re legyőzte a 2024-es bajnokot, Blinkyt. A GeoGuessrről és annak magyar közösségéről ebben a cikkben írtunk bővebben. https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-several-pup.text: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5N1Qm Footage posted online showed a male carrying a rifle near the school Image: DHA Advertisement A shooting near a high school in Turkey 's Manisa province resulted in at least 11 injured pupils, two of whom were in critical condition on Tuesday, Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said. The shooter, a pupil at the school, was arrested together with both of his parents and his grandfather. What do we know about the shooting incident? The suspect is said to have taken the weapon from his grandparents' house, with his grandfather believed to have had a licence for it. Local authorities said the attack took place at the Inci Uzmez Vocational and Technical Anatolian High School in the Turgutlu district at about 08:00am local time (07:00 CET). The motive for the shooting is also under investigation. Some reports suggest the student had suffered from bullying. Two back-to-back school shootings in April left around 10 killed and dozens more injured Image: Ensar Ozdemir/REUTERS "When the ​security of our children is the issue, it is not possible for any ​negligence, any irresponsibility to be overlooked," the minister posted on his X account. "The ‌circumstances under which the child obtained the gun used in the attack, the conditions of the weapon's storage, the parents' obligations regarding care ‌and supervision, and allegations of bullying prior to the incident ‌are ​being investigated thoroughly and from multiple angles," Gurlek added. Footage posted online showed a male carrying a rifle near the school, while police told families to stay away from the area. Gun control tightened after school shootings School shootings are rare in Turkey, but this year alone saw two back-to-back shootings that shocked the nation. Two school shootings that took place in April resulted in the tightening of gun controls and the increase of security measures at educational facilities as the academic year started last week. Several students and their teacher were killed in one of the attacks, with the other resulting in 16 people being injured. According to Interior Minister Mustafa Ciftci, 31,000 school supervisors and police officers on duty were assigned to school seen as being at risk, as per a new measure introduced only on Monday. President Recep Tayyip Erdogan responded to the latest shooting attack by promising even tighter gun controls. "When we look at similar attacks around the world, especially in the United States, we see one of the perpetrators' aims is to terrorise society," the Turkish leader said.
